headline: SEA @ WSN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 5.67 at WSN 3.71, with a projected total of 9.38. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SEA: SEA moved +1.53 runs while WSN moved -0.02, changing the projected margin by +1.55 runs. The projected total climbed +1.51, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -7.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Emerson Hancock has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Cole Young, Daylen Lile, Randy Arozarena, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Luke Raley, Patrick Wisdom because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
